tools.name: fawtar_list
tools.description:
List records from any Fawtar resource, with filtering, sorting and paging.

Resources:
- invoices: إصدار الفواتير الضريبية وقراءتها.
- credit_notes: تصحيح فاتورة صادرة بالخصم.
- debit_notes: تصحيح فاتورة صادرة بالزيادة.
- quotes: عروض الأسعار قبل تحوّلها إلى فواتير.
- orders: طلبات المتجر قبل الفوتر

tools.name: fawtar_get
tools.description: Fetch a single record by id. For invoices this also returns the line items and the public share link.

tools.name: fawtar_create
tools.description:
Create a customer, product, vendor, employee, asset or other simple record. Use fawtar_create_invoice for invoices — issuing one claims a sequential number, computes VAT, writes the QR and posts to the ledger, none of which a generic insert does.

Creatable resources: quotes, orders, customers, prod

tools.name: fawtar_create_invoice
tools.description:
Issue a tax or ordinary invoice. This is a real financial document: it takes the next sequential number, computes VAT, generates the ZATCA QR code and posts to the general ledger. It cannot be edited afterwards — correct it with a credit note. Confirm the amounts with the user before calling.

Use t

tools.name: fawtar_outstanding
tools.description: Every unpaid issued invoice with its remaining balance and how many days it is overdue, newest due first, plus the totals. This is the answer to 'who owes me money' without composing filters by hand.

tools.name: fawtar_vat_summary
tools.description: Output VAT charged on sales, input VAT paid on expenses, and the net payable for a date range — the figures a VAT return is built from. Recoverable input VAT only; expenses marked non-recoverable are excluded, as they must be.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "fawtar_create_invoice" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Issue a tax or ordinary invoice. This is a real financial document: it takes the next sequential number, computes VAT, generates the ZATCA QR code and posts to …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
